blocks.raw: <InfoBox title="Key Takeaway" type="success">Natural daylight integration with intelligent artificial lighting controls reduces energy consumption by 30–50% in perimeter zones while improving occupant visual comfort and wellbeing. PD 1096 Rule VIII and the Philippine Green Building Code establish minimum daylighting and maximum lighting power density standards; design coordination between orientation, shading, sensor placement, and control logic ensures compliance and operational efficiency in tropical climates.</InfoBox>

blocks.raw: <Leart type="note">For tropical climates, specify daylight harvesting setpoints with ±15–20% seasonal adjustment to account for monsoon-induced variation in baseline illuminance. Manual override controls enable occupant adaptation to unexpected weather changes and personal lighting preferences.</Leart>
